decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - 	The LB of Hounslow as the LPA hereby certify that on 3/8/05 the  
        	proposed erection of a hip to gable and rear roof  mansard extension  	                to the existing house would  have  been lawful within the meaning of  	                Sections 191 and 192 of the Town and  Country  Planning Act 1990, 	(as                 amended), for the following reason: 
       	The proposed development would  fall within Class B, Part 1,     
        	Schedule 2 of  The Town and Country Planning (General Permitted 
        	Development) Order 1995. 

           Informative 
           It should be noted that the roof extension would have to be built first before the            approved Planning Permission (00036/1/P2) for the side and rear extension  is constructed, in order for the roof extension to be permitted development.
description: Certificate of Lawfulness for the proposed erection of a hip to gable end and rear roof mansard extension to existing house
